method: Real MongoDB and localhost HTTP in isolated temporary QA databases; databases removed after test.

outcomes.name: private learning sessions and all alternative child paths enforce identity/class scope
stage skipping, invalid evidence, wrong age and locked lessons do not write progress
teacher creates a frozen Lesson assignment before learning starts
three real stages persist server-graded accuracy; retries and concurrent tabs do not duplicate events
Lesson completion appears in homework, supports review replacement and uses FAMILY identity
completing the Unit and retrying a final game grants one chest only
activity grading rejects empty/duplicate indexes; repeated submission is one result and stable session score
mastery events merge two devices, retry once, and stale absolute sync cannot overwrite counts
streak reads and preview do not mutate users or fabricate study dates
publication checklist and history guards reject destructive content edits
signed plans reject another child, tampered targets, and an unsigned completion
personal review, family week summary and teacher statistics include the three-stage path
new lessons stay in draft until media and game readiness pass
attendance and LIVE scoring run on real MongoDB, reject absent awards and deduplicate operations
closed-period recognition publishes once and reaches only its winning child
full backup restores BSON, indexes and credentials into a second empty QA database
registration has no shared PIN and changing PIN revokes the old JWT without weakening the password
